Same youthful boy throughout: warm peach skin, thick determined eyebrows, green cloth cap with gold band and red jewel, short dark ponytail, rosy cheeks, no moustache, no beard, no adult red face. Huge head, bean-short body, mitten fists, tiny feet, warm brown outlines, bright clean cel shading. Maintain same face and SAME HEAD SCALE in all five columns, no aging.
Landscape 3:2 high-resolution cream parchment design board, tasteful dark-jade gold header, subtle peach blossom corners, roomy layout. Exact main title 小关 · 五大成长节点. Five wide equal specimen columns left to right, with slim arrows, figures dominate. ONLY five main figures. Exact main labels and sublabels:

Horse must not dwarf rider, full mounted silhouette only about 40% taller than foot figure. Stage4: SAME mounted boy, SAME plain green outfit and SAME horse equipment and SAME guandao as3, do NOT add a new armor tier or redesign the weapon. Show him in a readable energetic guandao attack pose with three SMALL separated gold/jade crescent marks near the blade to indicate an unlocked THREE-HIT COMBO. This milestone changes attack behavior, not appearance. Keep face uncovered and effects modest. Stage5: the final distinct heroic appearance, SAME youthful face and small red horse, boy now wears JADE-WHITE plus bright EMERALD-GOLD short light commander armor, short red-edged split cape, pony gains a simple GOLD forehead guard and emerald-gold chest strap, eyes and playful face visible. Weapon is visually SAME iconic green-dragon guandao family with brighter jade edge, no new giant spear silhouette. Pony raises one short foreleg. Luxurious but clean simple shapes, not crowded scales/spikes.
Below the five figures, a slim readable reward strip with three badges: 每关首通 +1心 ; 赤壁解锁坐骑冲刺 ; 普通技能 + 固定冲刺. No Lv labels, no 7-stage progression, no incremental iron-band pole variants, no adult beard, no huge halos or full-screen dragons. Show all feet/hooves and all blade tips uncropped with ample spacing.

Design a polished matching GAME COMBAT CONCEPT BOARD for young Guan Yu 小关 in 桃园小英雄, using the reference only for the SAME boy identity and warm dark brown-outline bright cel-shaded chibi art. Warm peach skin, green cap gold band red jewel, no beard, bean-short body, very big expressive head. The SAME small round RED PONY with orange-red mane and stubby legs. The SAME iconic guandao: emerald shaft, silver crescent blade, gold dragon socket, small red tassel. This is a DESIGN PROPOSAL, not a screenshot or implemented game.

Large enough clear tap targets, 16px-like gap, no giant skill description card, no third attack button, no joystick in the lower right. Brief note 普通技能击杀充能 · 冲刺独立冷却. Footer exact 战斗表现概念 · 未实装.
